rule_or_requirement: Maintain high target speed and remain on asphalt; slowing or course cutting does not qualify.
observable_information: Four image frames, pixel road centers and HUD speed; evaluator-only raw road membership and speed are never agent inputs.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Repair pursuit single saturation, preserve target60 and all road/speed gates; repeat this arm of four-direction batch on same consumed six TRAIN cells.
expected_success_endpoint: Correct pursuit mechanism with identical frozen-control first-ten hashes; qualification unchanged.
control: Unmodified corridor steering with exactly the same fixed-speed governor; diagnostic controller, not selected submission ZIP.
falsifier: No qualified finish gain, target reduced, lost road constraint, unequal common prefixes, invalid actions or simulator state enters inference.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Six corrected pursuit episodes compared to immutable first-batch control; no fresh scoring.
resource_and_risk_gate: 2 CPU 2 GiB 600s, six episodes, no external action.
